rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for physically redirecting a road, stream, route, or flow.

example.english: The road is closed, so the cars have to divert.
example.jyutping: tiu4 lou6 fung1 zo2 di1 ce1 jiu3 goi2 dou6

rows.note: Use this when deliberately drawing someone's attention away from what they should be focusing on.

example.english: I pretended to fall down to divert attention so my colleague could get inside.
example.traditional: 我扮跌低，引開注意力，等同事入去。
example.jyutping: ngo5 baan6 dit3 dai1 jan5 hoi1 zyu3 ji3 lik6 dang2 tung4 si6 jap6 heoi3

rows.note: Use this when amusing or cheering someone up, rather than merely redirecting their attention.

example.english: I told a few jokes to divert everyone, and they all burst out laughing.
example.traditional: 我講幾個笑話氹人開心，成班人即刻笑晒。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gong2 gei2 go3 siu3 waa6 dam6 jan4 hoi1 sam1 sing4 baan1 jan4 zik1 hak1 siu3 saai3
